modules.title: Final Capstone Project
modules.description: Combine JavaScript fundamentals, browser APIs, asynchronous programming and professional practices.

lessons.title: Build the Complete Student Learning Platform
lessons.description: Build a realistic JavaScript-powered learning platform that loads course content, renders modules and lessons, displays notes and tasks, and tracks student progress.

notes.text: Final Project Goal

Create the JavaScript layer of a real learning platform. Course content should come from structured JSON or an API. Students should browse courses, open modules and lessons, read notes, view code examples, complete tasks and track progress.

notes.caption: Suggested flow: course data → state → lesson renderer → task completion → progress persistence.

notes.text: Required Features
Technical Expectations

items: Separate data, state and UI logic.

practicals.title: Architecture to Working App
practicals.objective: Turn the course JSON structure into a working learning interface.

tasks.title: Dedicated Task: Complete JavaScript Learning Platform
tasks.description: Build the complete learning experience using the concepts from the course.

quiz.question: What should the capstone demonstrate?
quiz.explanation: The capstone combines the major skills taught throughout the course.
